note: Records that are NOT in National_Health_Assurance_Framework_v2.0.0_FINAL.docx. The DOCX yields 430 (41 KPP + 79 TPP + 310 CP); the live catalog declares 440. These ten merit health-talent immigration KPP/TPP were added by hand in 2026-08 and are appended, in this order, after the extracted records. They are carried here so src/lib/quality-data.ts regenerates rather than being maintained by hand. Sourcing or quarantining them is R115.

records.name: Health workforce sufficiency ratio
records.calculation: filled safe-FTE / required safe-FTE across role-region cells, with no cell below its staffing floor
records.status: Plan-defined target; baseline and acceptance evidence required

rollout.interpretation: Controlled plan target assessed at maturity.

records.phaseNote: No numeric interim target is specified unless an earlier phase milestone or gate floor appears below.

records.name: Shortage-area staffing sufficiency
records.target: >=95% of designated HPSA and MUA positions filled
records.calculation: filled safe-FTE in designated shortage areas / required safe-FTE in those areas
records.status: Plan-defined target; baseline and acceptance evidence required

rollout.value: >=95% of designated HPSA and MUA positions filled
rollout.interpretation: Controlled plan target assessed at maturity.

records.phaseNote: No numeric interim target is specified unless an earlier phase milestone or gate floor appears below.

records.name: Merit immigration shortage-role fill rate
records.calculation: health-talent admissions placed into designated shortage occupations or regions / total health-talent admissions
records.status: Plan-defined target; baseline and acceptance evidence required

rollout.interpretation: Controlled plan target assessed at maturity.

records.phaseNote: No numeric interim target is specified unless an earlier phase milestone or gate floor appears below.

records.name: Internationally recruited clinician retention
records.calculation: internationally recruited clinicians in covered practice at 36 months / admitted cohort
records.status: Plan-defined target; baseline and acceptance evidence required

rollout.interpretation: Controlled plan target assessed at maturity.

records.phaseNote: No numeric interim target is specified unless an earlier phase milestone or gate floor appears below.

records.name: Role-region vacancy rate ceiling
records.calculation: vacant safe-FTE / authorized safe-FTE per role-region cell [fraction/percent]
records.status: Plan-defined target; baseline and acceptance evidence required

rollout.interpretation: Controlled plan target assessed at maturity.

records.phaseNote: No numeric interim target is specified unless an earlier phase milestone or gate floor appears below.

records.name: Training-slot to completed-hire conversion
records.calculation: publicly funded trainees credentialed and hired into covered roles / funded slots [fraction/percent]
records.status: Plan-defined target; baseline and acceptance evidence required

rollout.interpretation: Controlled plan target assessed at maturity.

records.phaseNote: No numeric interim target is specified unless an earlier phase milestone or gate floor appears below.

records.name: Merit selection shortage-occupation targeting
records.calculation: admissions in designated shortage occupations or regions / total health-talent admissions [fraction/percent]
records.status: Plan-defined target; baseline and acceptance evidence required

rollout.interpretation: Controlled plan target assessed at maturity.

records.phaseNote: No numeric interim target is specified unless an earlier phase milestone or gate floor appears below.

records.name: Health-talent petition processing time
records.calculation: median(decision time - complete filing time), met >=80% of the time [time]
records.status: Plan-defined target; baseline and acceptance evidence required

rollout.interpretation: Controlled plan target assessed at maturity.

records.phaseNote: No numeric interim target is specified unless an earlier phase milestone or gate floor appears below.

records.name: Credential recognition and licensing-bridge time
records.target: median <=6 months from arrival to full license
records.calculation: median(full-license date - arrival date) for admitted clinicians [time]
records.status: Plan-defined target; baseline and acceptance evidence required

rollout.value: median <=6 months from arrival to full license
rollout.interpretation: Controlled plan target assessed at maturity.

records.phaseNote: No numeric interim target is specified unless an earlier phase milestone or gate floor appears below.

records.name: Ethical recruitment safeguards compliance
records.calculation: compliant recruitment events / total recruitment events [fraction/percent]
records.status: Plan-defined target; baseline and acceptance evidence required

rollout.interpretation: Controlled plan target assessed at maturity.

records.phaseNote: No numeric interim target is specified unless an earlier phase milestone or gate floor appears below.
